posts.title: My Second iPhone Lives at Home. I Use It From Anywhere.
posts.description: I have two phone numbers in two countries. For a long time that meant two phones: one in my pocket, one in a drawer or a bag, and the second one was always the wrong one. A bank sends its code to the old number. A messaging account is tied to it. Someone who only has that number calls while it is at the bottom of a backpack on silent.

posts.title: Hang Up, and It Rings Once More
posts.description: My second iPhone lives at home, and my main phone rings when it rings ( the setup ). The gateway at home sees the incoming call and sends my main phone an Apple VoIP push; the TracePort app turns that into a normal incoming-call screen with CallKit.
